description: Cambridgeshire County Council Bridges is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Cambridgeshire County Council. Bridges owned or maintained by Cambridgeshire County Council or those owned by third parties that carry or interact with highways maintained by Cambridgeshire County Council. Coverage: Cambridgeshire County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Cambridgeshire County Council. It offers 2 resource(s) in WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-06-12 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
